Datum: 1997-09-30 Talare: Riksbankschef Urban Bckstrm Plats: Stora Rntedagen i Stockholm Frst vill jag tacka fr inbjudan och mjligheten att f diskutera svensk ekonomi och hur Riksbanken ser p inflationsutsikterna. I den Inflationsrapport som Riksbanken presenterade frra veckan drogs slutsatsen att penningpolitiken i dagslget r vl avvgd. I rapporten grs som alltid i detta sammanhang det tekniska antagandet att penningpolitiken r ofrndrad, dvs att reporntan ligger kvar p 4,10 procent, nda in i 1999 i syfte att analysera vad detta leder till fr effekter p efterfrgan och prisutveckling. Detta antagande innebr naturligtvis inte att vi kan lova att reporntan kommer att vara ofrndrad de nrmaste ren. Med en vl avvgd penningpolitik menar vi att reporntan inte behver ndras under den nrmaste tiden fr att inflationsmlet p 2 procent ska uppns inom den tidshorisont som penningpolitiken verkar, dvs vanligen mellan 1 och 2 r. Men vr analys av ekonomin och inflationsriskerna fr de kommande ren r inte utan reservationer. Det sgs i rapporten att det med nuvarande konjunkturutveckling r srskilt viktigt att noga flja inkommande information fr att bedma om inflationsbilden ndras. Det r helt naturligt mot bakgrund av den upptgende konjunkturen och vr beslutsamhet att uppfylla prisstabilitetsmlet. Det finns oskerhetsfaktorer och det r ngra sdana som jag tnker diskutera idag. Den diskussionen fr dock inte frta huvudintrycket att svensk ekonomi idag har ett mycket bttre utgngslge n p lnge. Vi har goda frutsttningar att f uppleva en tid med varaktigt hg tillvxt och fortsatt lg inflation. Det r ngot som mste frvaltas vl. En frsta oskerhetsfaktor som r central fr inflationsutvecklingen r konjunkturfrloppet. Det reser i sin tur frgan om och hur resursutnyttjandet utvecklas i ekonomin. En andra faktor r utvecklingen av inflationsfrvntningarna och en tredje r lnebildningen. Lt mig ta dessa faktorer i tur och ordning, men frst repetera ngot om grunderna fr prisstabilitetsmlet. Prisstabilitetsmlet Bortser vi frn olika faktorer som orsakat engngsfrndringar av prisnivn uppt eller nedt, och drmed endast tillflligt pverkat inflationstakten, kan man konstatera att bde faktisk och frvntad inflation under 1990-talet successivt nrmat sig prisstabilitetsmlet. Vi hller drmed p att verg frn en situation d den ekonomiska politiken behvde inriktas p att ta ned inflationen till ett lge dr det gller att lngsiktigt hlla prisutvecklingen i linje med prisstabilitetsmlet. Av central betydelse fr en sdan politik r ekonomins kapacitet att producera varor och tjnster. Denna r inte utan grnser. Historien lr oss att nr efterfrgan kar snabbare n vad ekonomin uthlligt frmr producera kar efter hand risken fr att kapacitetsbegrnsningar och flaskhalsar leder till stigande priser och lner. Om en situation av den hr typen riskerar att uppst r det bttre att p ett tidigt stadium ska bromsa frloppet ngot med en liten rntehjning s att efterfrgeutvecklingen blir i linje med utbyggnaden av ekonomins produktionskapacitet. D kan tillvxten bli uthllig. Genom att agera frutsgbart och i god tid kan frhoppningsvis kraftiga frndringar i rntelget undvikas och ekonomins aktrer kan samtidigt fortstta att utg frn en stabilt lg inflation. Det r viktigt att notera att den lngsiktiga tillvxtbanan bestms av faktorer som uppbyggnad och anvndning av fysiskt kapital, av hur arbetskraftens kunskaper utvecklas och anvnds, samt av den tekniska utvecklingen. Ingen av dessa grundlggande tillvxtfaktorer kan direkt pverkas av frndringen av Riksbankens repornta. Vad penningpolitiken kan gra r att skapa skerhet kring den framtida inflationsutvecklingen och drmed sannolikt indirekt bidra till att hja tillvxtpotentialen. En ryckig och odisciplinerad penningpolitik kan p samma stt snka produktionspotentialen. En penningpolitik som syftar till att bevara en lg inflation behver inte vara ofrenlig med en ekonomi som vxer med t.ex. 4 eller 5 procent. Frutsttningen fr en s hg tillvxt r dock att ekonomins utbudssida fungerar s bra att tillvxten inte ger upphov till inflationsimpulser. Om ekonomins struktur  andra sidan enbart medger en tillvxt p 1 eller 2 procent, mste efterfrgan och drmed penningpolitiken anpassas efter det. Nr prisstabilitetsmlet etablerats som ett trovrdigt riktmrke kan man sga att mlsttningen att inflationen varaktigt varken stiger ver eller faller under mlet i normalfallet motsvaras av en strvan att ekonomin varken producerar ver eller under sin lngsiktigt uthlliga kapacitet. Penningpolitikens inriktning p att bidra till en stabil och uthllig tillvxt underlttas av prisstabilitetsmlets konstruktion. Nr konjunkturen frsvagas blir inflationstrycket normalt lgre. Det kan ge utrymme fr rntesnkningar. P samma vis finns det vanligen skl att strama t penningpolitiken efter en tid av stigande efterfrgan om den kar snabbare n utbyggnaden av ekonomins kapacitet. Det r allts fel att pst att inga hnsyn tas i penningpolitiken till sysselsttning och tillvxt. Upplggningen av penningpolitiken innebr att hnsyn tas till produktions- och sysselsttningen s lnge det inte ventyrar den lga inflationen. Denna typ av hnsynstagande sker automatiskt med den symmetriska inriktning som ett prisstabilitetsml innebr. Strningar som innebr engngsfrndringar av prisnivn och som leder till tillflligt hgre eller lgre inflation ska normalt kunna fngas upp av toleransintervallet. Ibland kan sdana strningar dock bli s stora att inflationen hamnar utanfr intervallet och att inflationsmlet, som skall utvrderas i ett lngre, rligt perspektiv, inte uppfylls. Detta skedde som bekant under 1996 d inflationen, mtt fr ret som helhet, med ngra tiondelar understeg den lgre toleransgrnsen. En viktigt orsak var att den kraftiga rntesnkningen bidrog till att rntekostnaderna fr egnahem minskade. Vid situationer d inflationen hamnar utanfr intervallet r det Riksbankens uppgift att dels ge en frklaring till det som intrffar, dels gra trovrdigt att penningpolitikens upplggning r sdan att inflationen successivt tergr till mlet p 2 procent. Det gller oavsett om det handlar om ett verskridande av den vre toleransgrnsen eller ett underskridande av den lgre toleransgrnsen. Den nedgng av KPI-talen som frra ret ledde till att inflationen kom under den nedre grnsen fr prisstabilitetsmlets toleransintervall var tillfllig. Den registrerade inflationen nrmar sig nu ter den underliggande inflationen kring 2 procent. Detta r allts en frutsedd kning och i grunden inte ngot som pverkar penningpolitiken och det gjorde inte den tillflliga nedgngen frra ret heller. Vrt agerande r allts symmetriskt i detta avseende. Konjunkturfrloppet och resursutnyttjandet I Inflationsrapporten som presenterades frra veckan konstateras att terhmtningen i den svenska ekonomin fortstter. Riksbanken bedmer, i likhet med tidigare, att BNP-kningen kan bli omkring 2 procent i r och runt 3 procent under 1998 och 1999. Trots att kningen av efterfrgan i ekonomin drmed sannolikt kommer att ligga ver den tillvxttakt som ekonomins utbudssida i lngden klarar av att mta, torde inte ngra generella kapacitetsbrister komma att uppst under de nrmaste ren. Det mesta talar nmligen fr att det finns lediga resurser i ekonomin som kan tas i ansprk vid en sdan efterfrgekning. Dessutom ser uppgngen ut att bli relativt jmnt frdelad mellan export- och hemmamarknad, vilket ocks bidrar till att motverka inflationsdrivande flaskhalsproblem. I frnvaro av allvarliga spnningar mellan ekonomins efterfrge- och utbudssida borde den underliggande inflationen vara i stort sett konstant under den tidshorisont som penningpolitiken arbetar med, dvs ett till tv r framt i tiden. Att kningstakten av konsumentprisindex nd kommer att tillta ngot framver har att gra med tillflliga faktorer, som jag pekade p tidigare. Den processen har redan brjat. Den registrerade inflationstakten har successivt stigit i r frn som lgst 0 procent i vras till 1,5 procent enligt den senaste siffran. Den genomsnittliga inflationen enligt KPI vntas stiga frn omkring 1 procent 1997 till omkring 2 procent 1998 och 1999. Till fljd av att penningpolitikens genomslag p efterfrgan prglas av lng efterslpning, tvingas vi arbeta med mer eller mindre oskra prognoser om konjunkturutvecklingen under de nrmaste tv ren. Vi r inte ensamma om att arbeta med prognoser. Det r ngot som mnga aktrer i ekonomin gr. Vi publicerar fyra Inflationsrapporter per r fr att fortlpande stmma av hur utvecklingen ter sig och vid behov kunna revidera bedmningarna. Vi vet inte exakt hur mycket ekonomin kan producera utan att inflationen stiger. S kallade produktionsgapsberkningar - dvs frsk att mta skillnaden mellan faktisk produktion och den produktionsniv vid vilken inflationen riskerar att stiga - r i grunden fr oskra fr att vara en exakt styrra fr det penningpolitiska agerandet. Drfr gller det att ocks se hur resursutnyttjandet i ekonomins olika delar utvecklas. Olika mtt fr industrin visar p ett ngot stigande kapacitetsutnyttjande mellan frsta och andra kvartalet i r i svensk ekonomi. I Konjunkturinstitutets konjunkturbarometer har andelen fretag som uppgav att det var tillgngen p produktionsfaktorer som begrnsade produktionen kat ngot. Dessutom skedde under andra kvartalet en viss kning av bristtalen fr yrkesarbetare och tekniska tjnstemn. ven i tjnstesektorn har det skett en kning av kapacitetsutnyttjandet. Likas har leveranstiderna kat ngot under andra kvartalet. Ytterligare tecken p att kapacitetsutnyttjandet har kat i ekonomin r att andelen fretag som har fr avsikt att hja sina priser under tredje kvartalet r ngot strre n de som sger att de kommer att snka priserna. Det mesta talar allts fr att resursutnyttjandet i ekonomin stigit ngot, men huvudhypotesen r nd att tillgngen p resurser alltjmt r tillrckligt god fr att kunna mta en stigande efterfrgan. En ekonomi som vxer snabbt kan uppleva tillflliga flaskhalsproblem eftersom nya anlggningar inte alltid kan tas i bruk vid exakt den tid d efterfrgekningen kommer. Erfarenheten frn uppgngen 1994 och 1995, som i huvudsak var frlagd till industrisektorn, tyder visserligen p en hgre flexibilitet n tidigare nr det gller svl anvndning av den existerande kapitalstocken som att snabbt investera i nya maskiner och anlggningar nr efterfrgan stiger. Men efterfrgan var d s starkt i industrisektorn att det nd uppstod kapacitetsproblem med en acceleration av producentpriserna som fljd. Det kan ocks ta en viss tid fr fretagen att f sitt arbetskraftsbehov tillgodosett till fljd av "matchningsproblem" p arbetsmarknaden. Det r inte ndvndigtvis s att efterfrgan nu kommer i exakt de branscher och i de regioner som drabbades av efterfrgebortfall i brjan av 1990-talet. Den ofrndrade nivn p antalet kvarstende lediga platser tyder p vissa matchningsproblem p arbetsmarknaden. Den komplicerade strukturen i en ekonomi gr det ndvndigt att flja mnga olika faktorer fr att skapa sig en bild av resursutnyttjandet i ekonomin och fr att kunna bedma om det finns en risk fr flaskhalsproblem som kan leda till en acceleration av inflationen. nnu s lnge tyder inte utvecklingen p att inflationsriskerna framver skulle vara fr stora. Men vi befinner oss i en upptgende konjunktur och det r ndvndigt att vara vaksam p om bilden frndras. Inflationsfrvntningarna Hur viktigt det r att f ned inflationsfrvntningarna till en niv som r i linje med prisstabilitetsmlet har under 1990-talet manifesterats genom en rad ekonomiskpolitiska beslut. Formuleringen av mlet fr Riksbankens penningpolitik, tstramningen av penningpolitiken mellan sommaren 1994 och under 1995 och flerpartiuppgrelsen om Riksbankens stllning r exempel p detta. Budgetsaneringen har ocks pverkats av prisstabilitetsmlet, ven om den drutver har styrts av andra motiv. Denna betoning av prisstabilitet har ocks lett till resultat. Inflationsfrvntningarna har, ssom de framkommer i olika enktunderskningar, fallit markant under senare r. Nedgngen i lnga rntan, liksom den starkare kronan r ocks en terspegling av detta. Kontrasten r nu stor till 1970- och 1980-talens inflation p i genomsnitt 8 procent per r. Vi har kommit en bra bit p vg att etablera frtroende fr lginflationspolitiken. Det r dock vsentligt att noga flja utvecklingen av inflationsfrvntningarna i samband med den pgende konjunkturuppgngen. Det fr inte rda ngon tvekan om prisstabilitetsmlets viktiga roll i den samlade ekonomiska politiken och att Riksbanken tar denna uppgift p fullaste allvar. I en milj dr inflationsfrvntningarna r fast frankrade vid inflationsmlet har penningpolitiken ett visst manverutrymme och kan stdja terhmtningen i ekonomin. Det framgr inte minst av utvecklingen i de lnder dr lg inflation prglat utvecklingen en lngre period. Det kan synas som en paradox att ju mer trovrdig en centralbank r i sin inflationsbekmpning, desto strre manverutrymme finns att stdja den allmnna ekonomiska politiken. Men ordningen mste vara precis denna. Frst kommer trovrdigheten och sedan manverutrymmet - inte tvrt om. Det var detta synstt som var vgledande fr Riksbanken nr vi vntade med att snka styrrntan till i januari 1996 - vi ville arbeta med skerhetsmarginaler och bekrfta inriktningen mot lg inflation. De som i debatten d inte sg penningpolitiken p detta stt hoppas jag gr det idag. Det r genom prisstabilitet, lga inflationsfrvntningar och drmed lga marknadsrntor ver hela avkastningskurvan som penningpolitiken kan bidra till en uthllig - lt mig betona uthllig - tillvxt. Utan den trovrdighet som inflationsfrvntningar i linje med mlet innebr, riskerar penningpolitiska stimulanser att ter fra ekonomin tillbaka in i inflationselndet med negativa konsekvenser fr produktion och sysselsttning. Inte ndvndigtvis fr att en marginell avvikelse frn 2 procents inflation skulle vara katastrofal fr ekonomins stt att fungera, utan fr att vi d skulle tappa det tydliga ankare som ett prisstabilitetsml innebr fr svl den ekonomiska politiken som fr ekonomins aktrer. Vi behver bara g tillbaka till i brjan av 1970-talet fr att se vad en sdan frlust innebar fr utvecklingen p ekonomins mnga omrden. Sammanbrottet av Bretton Woods-systemet, som Sverige var medlem av, bildade upptakten till en lng period av varierande och hg inflation. Det r av den anledningen som inflationsmlet mste vrdas med omsorg. Det ger en tydlig referenspunkt och ett klart besked till olika beslutsfattare i ekonomin om den ekonomiska politikens inriktning. I Sverige brjade lginflationsregimen etableras frst i brjan av 1990-talet, vilket gr att vi mste vara speciellt vaksamma p om den politik som frs spiller ver i stigande inflationsfrvntningar. Risken fr detta har med all sannolikhet minskat de senaste ren, dels med tanke p att inflationen varit lg, dels till fljd av att statsmakterna i handling visat att prisstabilitet r en central del av den ekonomiska politiken. Men vaksamheten mste finnas, srskilt som nu nr penningpolitiken har en stimulerande inverkan p ekonomin. Med inflationsfrvntningar i linje med mlet skapas stabila frutsttningar fr de mnga kontrakt som ings varje dag i en dynamisk ekonomi. Det gller inte minst p arbetsmarknaden, vilket blir tydligt nu nr vi str infr en mycket viktig avtalsrrelse. Lnebildningen Lnebildningen pverkas naturligtvis i vsentlig grad av hur hg inflationen frvntas bli i framtiden. De senaste rens frhllandevis stora lnekningar, den hga arbetslsheten till trots, frklaras sannolikt till stor del av att d avtalen slts frvntades inflationen bli betydligt hgre n vad den faktiskt sedan blev. Lnekningarna hamnade drmed p en niv som inte medgav en nedgng i arbetslsheten. Frutom inflationsfrvntningarna spelar de institutionella frhllandena p arbetsmarknaden, eller, mer allmnt uttryckt, arbetsmarknadens funktionsstt, en stor roll fr lneutvecklingen. Det r svrt att idag ha ngon klar uppfattning om huruvida de samtal som frts om den framtida lnebildningen samt de samarbetsavtal som trffats inom vissa delar av arbetsmarknaden kommer att leda till en bttre fungerande lnebildning frn 1998. I grunden r det resultat som rknas och nivn p arbetslsheten ger en fingervisning om problemen inom lnebildningen. Av stor betydelse fr det framtida lneutrymmet r hur produktiviteten kommer att utvecklas. Den genomsnittliga kningen i arbetsproduktiviteten har under 1990-talet varit betydligt hgre n under 1980-talet. Frgan r dock om det handlar om en varaktig kning som kan lggas till grund fr den framtida lnebildningen eller om det finns frklaringar av mer tillfllig karaktr. ven om de senaste rens frndringar i den svenska ekonomin sannolikt kommer att resultera i en frbttrad framtida produktivitet, frefaller det vara fr tidigt att idag dra lngtgende slutsatser om ett strukturellt trendbrott i produktivitetsutvecklingen. Den hgre produktiviteten under 1990-talet frefaller nmligen till en del kunna frklaras av faktorer av tillfllig karaktr. I samband med kostnadskrisen och den stora nedgngen av produktionen i brjan av decenniet genomfrdes stora rationaliseringar inom svenskt nringsliv. Dessa resulterade i att sysselsttningen, mtt svl i antal anstllda som i arbetade timmar, fll mer n produktionen under brjan av 1990-talet, vilket kunde avlsas i en kad arbetsproduktivitet. En annan effekt av vergende natur som kan ha bidragit till den hga registrerade produktiviteten de senaste ren r att nr konjunkturen stiger kan fretagen normalt klara efterfrgekningen i brjan av uppsvinget med den befintliga arbetsstyrkan. Historiskt sett har konjunkturuppgngar varit frknippade med strre frbttringar av produktiviteten. ver konjunkturcykeln brukar emellertid sdana variationer i produktiviteten jmnas ut. Det kan dessutom inte uteslutas att de hgre lnekningarna under senare r franlett rationaliseringar som syftat till att motverka en uppgng i kostnaderna. Inte heller detta r en produktivitetseffekt som kan anvndas som ett argument fr lnekningar, srskilt inte om mlet r att f ned arbetslsheten. Den framtida lnebildningen r allts ytterligare en riskfaktor som Riksbanken mste vga in. Det finns uppmuntrande tecken som tyder p att lnebildningen r p rtt vg, men det r ndvndigt att ocks arbetslsheten minskar varaktigt fr att man ska kunna sga att lnebildningen inte utgr ngot problem. Avslutning Riksbankens bedmning r att penningpolitiken fr nrvarande r vl avvgd. En penningpolitik som styrs av ett prisstabilitetsml innebr att det frmst r den inhemska utvecklingen och bedmningen av den framtida inflationen i Sverige som bestmmer behovet av rntefrndring. Vi pverkas sledes inte direkt av om rntan hjs eller snks i andra lnder. Detta visade sig tidigare nr andra lnder snkte rntan och Riksbanken lg kvar p en hgre niv och det visar sig nu nr Finland hjt sin styrrnta medan vi hller rntan ofrndrad. Svensk ekonomi har goda frutsttningar att komma in i en fas med varaktigt hg tillvxt baserad p stabila makroekonomiska frhllanden. Fr att det ska vara mjligt mste vi vara vaksamma p om det intrffar frndringar som kan gra att inflation stiger. Detta r srskilt viktigt nu under de nrmaste ren nr tillvxten vntas ligga hgre n den trendmssiga. Det r i detta lge viktigt att diskutera ngra av de risker som kan ligga framfr oss, trots att lget verkar bra ven med hnsyn till dessa risker som de ter sig i dag. Om arbetsuppdelningen r sdan att vi i Riksbanken har till uppgift att identifiera potentiella risker, s kan frhoppningsvis alla andra gna sig t att dra frdel av den stabila ekonomiska utveckling som prisstabiliteten erbjuder. Det r flera decennier sedan svensk ekonomi upplevde s gynnsamma frhllanden som nu rder. Om arbetsmarknaden fungerar tillfredsstllande kan utvecklingen ocks leda till att arbetslsheten varaktigt brjar minska under de nrmaste ren. Den frestende uppgngen kommer att visa om s blir fallet. Title: The Real Estate Market and the Financial Crisis
text: Wickman-Parak: The real estate market and the financial crisis Date: 2009-06-17 Speaker: Deputy Governor Barbro Wickman-Parak Location: Fastighetsagarna, Stockholm American actor Danny Kaye once said that ""It takes more than money to make a person happy. You also have to have stocks, gold and real estate." The experience of the 1990s has taught us that the conditions for happiness defined in this way can vary very significantly. The question for my speech is whether the developments we are seeing today in the property market could develop into a repeat of the real estate crisis we experienced in the early 1990s. My answer is that while we see risks in the real estate market, there are no real signs that the current recession will mean a replay of the real estate crisis of the 1990s. But before I explain why, let me start by telling you why the Riksbank is engaged in analyzing the real estate market. Next, I will discuss how we assess the state of the market today, both in terms of the housing market and the commercial real estate market. With regard to the commercial real estate market, I will also make some flashbacks and comparisons with the crisis of the 1990s. The Riksbank, financial stability and the real estate market The Riksbank has a well-rooted institutional memory of the banking crisis in the 1990s, which was very much a real estate crisis. Rough calculations show that about two-thirds of banks' credit losses in the 1990s came from the real estate sector. (1) The Swedish banking crisis, unlike the current crisis, originated here at home. It was also against the background of the Swedish banking crisis that the Riksbank began to analyse and monitor the stability of the Swedish financial system in a more systematic and comprehensive manner. The financial stability reports that we subsequently began to publish have become a valuable tool for us. In them, we present our results and identify the risks that may exist to the stability of the financial system. A considerable part of the banks' lending today takes place to Swedish real estate companies, namely around nine percent of their total lending stock. Although the share of such loans is smaller than in the 1990s, when the share was about one third, it is still of such a size that it represents a significant potential credit risk for the major Swedish banks. Let me therefore begin by saying something about the current state of the housing and commercial real estate markets and their importance for financial stability. Low interest rates have stabilized the housing market... Between 1996 and 2008, house prices rose by nearly 160 percent. A good income development  households' disposable income increased by almost 65 per cent over the period  was a major contributor to the rise in prices. But another strong contributing factor was that mortgage rates generally fell during the period, so that the interest rate ratio, i.e. interest payments in relation to disposable income, fell. In addition, competition between players in the mortgage market also increased. The increased competition led to lower interest margins and more generous loan terms, for example, households could get amortisation-free loans and lenders allowed higher loan-to-value ratios. This meant that the amount that the borrower no longer had to amortize could instead be used to pay interest on a slightly larger loan. The rate of increase in house prices started to moderate in the latter part of 2007. The Riksbank's successive interest rate hikes from the beginning of 2006 onwards should have contributed to this development. Towards the end of last year, house prices began to fall back, partly as a result of an unusually large supply of housing that was not met by increased demand. The latter was a natural consequence of the general loss of confidence among households in the wake of the crisis. At year-end, prices of villas had fallen by two per cent and prices of condominiums had fallen nine per cent compared to a year earlier. After the turn of the year, however, the situation in the housing market seems to have stabilised. Home buyers have become more active and sales times have come down. A burgeoning optimism is also confirmed in SBAB's latest broker barometer. In it, demand is expected to increase, sales times to come down further while prices are expected to increase slightly. ... but deteriorating labour markets could lead to price falls later on The strongest contributing factor to the housing market regaining its courage is probably that mortgage rates have fallen sharply since December last year as a result of the Riksbank's repo rate cuts. One could almost say that home prices right now are a bit doped up by the low interest rates, but when the notices start to turn into actual layoffs, the demand for housing will slow down, which should have consequences for price formation. One should therefore not be surprised if prices fall a little further down the line. There will be no question of any collapse that would come even close to what was recorded in the 1990s, when real house prices fell by close to 30 percent from top to bottom. Although experience shows that house prices often co-vary between countries, there are several factors that suggest that house prices will fall slightly less in Sweden than in other countries. Among other things, Sweden's housing investments in relation to GDP have been at a much lower level compared to, for example, Denmark, Spain and the United States. There is also a housing shortage in almost half of Sweden's municipalities. Another factor that speaks for this is that Swedish households buy their homes to live in, not to rent out. In the UK, where house prices are now falling sharply, however, there has been a large market for so-called "buy-to-let". This means that a house or apartment can be bought to be subleased. This feature is largely absent from the Swedish housing market. An important issue in terms of financial stability is the extent to which falling house prices affect credit losses in banks. We do not believe that this will lead to any significant increase in credit risk on banks' balance sheets, as we believe that households will still be able to pay on their loans. In recent years, the Riksbank has put a lot of effort into analysing how the Swedish household sector's ability to pay is affected by changes in interest rates and unemployment. Our analysis is based on so-called "microdata", i.e. data on individual households. This analysis shows that Swedish households' ability to pay on their housing loans is not particularly affected by higher unemployment. This is due to a combination of an overall fine-meshed social safety net, as well as the fact that the largest debts are found in households with two income earners. Of course, there are exceptions, such as borrowers who, for one reason or another, are not covered by unemployment benefits, or households where both income earners have the same employer, which means that the risk of both income earners becoming unemployed at the same time increases. But, despite these exceptions, we find it difficult to see that the ongoing recession would lead to many households no longer being able to pay on their loans. This conclusion is also supported by Sweden's experience in the 1990s, when only a very limited part of the banks' credit losses could be attributed to the household sector despite the large fall in house prices and rapidly rising unemployment. We currently have an extremely low key interest rate and, in this context, I would also like to emphasise to prospective home buyers that the interest rate situation today is far lower than can be expected on average over a business cycle. It is important to remember that mortgage rates will go up as the economy recovers. You should take this with you when you make your housing calculation. Prices fall on commercial real estate If we shift our focus to the commercial real estate market, we can first note that prices have fallen. More precisely, in 2008, commercial real estate prices fell by eight percent compared to 2007. (2) It is not only in Sweden that prices have fallen and historically there is a high degree of co-variation in prices in the real estate markets between countries. Examples of commercial real estate markets where prices have fallen more than they have in Sweden are the Irish, British and Norwegian. Here, prices fell by between 10 and 30 percent. Even in the Baltic States, the prices of commercial real estate have dropped drastically. The category of commercial real estate that was hardest hit during the crisis of the 1990s was the office market. Therefore, it is interesting to compare how this market developed during the current recession compared to the crisis of the 1990s. Real prices for office space in Stockholm's city centre fell by almost 70 per cent from the highest level in 1989 to the lowest level in 1993. If we compare with recent developments, we see that corresponding prices have fallen by almost 15% between the last quarter of 2007, when the highest price was recorded, and the first quarter of 2009. (3) So, although we can currently observe sharp price falls, they are, so far, much more modest compared to the cases recorded during the 1990s crisis. And while it is reasonable to believe that prices may continue to fall in the future, in our judgment it is not the issue of price collapse that can be likened to said crisis. Major differences compared to the crisis of the 1990s These days, it is common to try to compare the current situation with the crisis of the 1990s. Therefore, let's take a closer look at the similarities and differences between developments in the real estate market now and during the real estate cycle of the 1980s until the onset of the real estate crisis. An important prerequisite for prices to rise so much in the second half of the 1980s was the deregulation of the credit market. As there was a large pent-up demand for credit, deregulation brought about rapid credit growth. A large part of the new credits were just real estate related. In 1992, lending for real estate represented almost a third of the major banks' total outstanding loans. During the late 1980s, new construction also increased rapidly and when the crisis set in, vacancy rates rose sharply. If we compare with the situation today, we see that although lending to real estate companies increased in the early 2000s, it did not increase at all to the same extent as before the real estate crisis. Nor has new construction increased to the same extent as it did in the late 1980s. Although the vacancy rate rose in the years after the turn of the millennium and the IT crisis, it could not at all match the levels of the 1990s crisis. As a share of the major Swedish banks' total lending, Swedish real estate companies currently also represent a smaller share than then, although they represent the largest corporate sector to which the major Swedish banks lend. But the key difference compared to the real estate crisis of the 1990s is interest rates that are now much lower as a result of the fact that the current monetary policy is focused on defending an inflation target and not a fixed exchange rate. During the real estate crisis, we saw high nominal interest rates that, combined with rapidly falling inflation, meant high real interest rates. Many real estate companies were squeezed between falling revenues and the rapidly rising interest rates. The costs of real estate companies' loans increased significantly and ultimately meant that several, especially highly leveraged, real estate companies found it difficult to pay interest and amortization on their loans. This, in turn, led to increased credit losses for banks. Today, the interest rates that real estate companies need to pay for their loans are significantly lower than they were in the 1990s. At the same time, real estate companies are generally less leveraged than was the case in the 1990s and their financial position is generally better today than it was then. In addition, the banks' credit assessment in the early 2000s followed a different philosophy than before the real estate crisis in the 1990s. At that time, the banks focused largely on the value of the pledges, values that quickly eroded as prices subsequently fell. Nowadays, banks are putting more focus on customers' cash flows and thus their ability to pay on their loans. In this context, it is also worth saying that the element of both foreign investors and financiers appears to be greater in the 2000s than in the 1990s. When we talk today about increased difficulties in finding financing as a result of the financial crisis, it also seems to be first and foremost the foreign investors and foreign financiers who have withdrawn. Foreign investors are also the ones who have had the largest share of borrowed capital in their purchases, which is why they are also the ones who have been hit relatively hardest in the financial crisis and by the difficulties in finding financing. ... but also some similarities Although there are major differences between then and now, there are also some similarities. Simply put, the price of a property is determined by two factors, namely the expected operating surplus on the property and the remuneration requirement that the investor has. The fact that investors are prepared to pay more for a property can therefore be a consequence either of expecting rental income to increase or not requiring the capital they invest to generate as much in return. From the mid-1980s to 1990, prices rose significantly more than rents. The same pattern recurred during the price rise from 2005 to 2007. What we can say, then, is that the price development over the two periods has not been driven by what we usually call fundamental factors. That is, prices have not increased due to an increased demand for office space, lower vacancies and increased rents. Instead, the rise in prices has been due to the fact that investors have no longer demanded such a high return on their investments and by the end of 2007 the risk premium was closer to zero. However, the development between 2005 and 2007 was not nearly as dramatic as in the 1980s, when the real estate bubble was built up. The required rate of return in the 1980s was at times even lower than the yield on a government bond, meaning that those who invested in commercial real estate did not require any compensation for the risk they took to invest in real estate. Another similarity between then and now is how events in the financial markets can affect the commercial real estate market. Somewhat to the point, it can be said that the crisis in the real estate market began in the autumn of 1990 when the finance company Nyckeln could not refinance its loans. When The Key and the other finance companies could no longer continue with their lending to the real estate companies, it was the beginning of the end for the credit-driven price increase. As in the 1990s, the current financial crisis has meant that it has become more difficult for real estate companies to find financing. Finally, it can be mentioned that banks on an overall level, i.e. not only in the case of real estate-related loans, are facing significant credit losses. The Riksbank's assessment in the latest stability report is that credit losses in the main scenario amount to just over two per cent of banks' lending in 2009 and 2010. In a stress scenario, with significantly weaker real economic developments, they are projected to amount to 4.3% of lending over the same period. Those are big losses but still significantly more limited than during the 1990s crisis. At that time, credit losses in 1991-1994 amounted to 13% of average lending over the same period and, as already mentioned, two thirds of losses were attributable to real estate-related loans. This time, the single largest source of loss is loans to the Baltic States and the rest of Eastern Europe. In both the main and stress scenarios, credit losses in that lending are estimated to account for around 40% of total losses. No new 1990s crisis but still an uncertain situation Thus, there are several reasons for the assessment that we will avoid a new real estate crisis of the 1990s; interest rates are today more favourable, the current situation has not been preceded by the type of construction boom that preceded the crisis of the 1990s, banks' lending today focuses more on the ability of real estate companies to pay than the value of their assets, and loan-to-value ratios are generally lower today compared to the 1990s. But the uncertainty in the market is still great and it is worth highlighting the risks we see ahead. Firstly, we are in a deep recession and exactly how much it will affect the demand for premises is difficult to predict. Of great importance for the demand for office space is employment in the service sector. Like employment in general, we have seen that employment in the services sector has slowed down. On the other hand, the slowdown has come later in the services sector than it has in the industrial sectors. However, it is estimated that employment in the services sector will moderate further. Against this background, it is reasonable to expect that we will see weaker rental growth and increased vacancies. The real estate companies' earnings and ability to pay interest and amortization will thus deteriorate and we risk seeing more payment defaults, even among real estate companies. Secondly, the falling prices of real estate can become a problem for real estate companies when they have to reschedule their loans with the banks if they do not live up to the banks' requirements for the maximum allowable loan-to-value ratio. Thirdly, the increased presence of foreign banks in the Swedish real estate market in recent years is a certain concern. This is because, as a result of the financial crisis, these banks are now withdrawing and not rescheduling loans on the Swedish market. Admittedly, Swedish listed real estate companies appear to be less dependent on financing from foreign banks overall. Nevertheless, the other types of actors that depend on this type of financing could have difficulties in refinancing their loans or obtaining financing from Swedish banks. The withdrawal of foreign financiers could also mean another element of uncertainty in the Swedish commercial real estate market in general and make it appear less attractive. Fourthly, there is a risk that real estate companies' interest costs may increase more than their earnings when the economy picks up and interest rates thus rise. This could make it more difficult for them to pay off their loans. Slutord A couple of weeks ago, we published a new stability report. Compared to our assessment in the November report, we now no longer see liquidity risk as the biggest risk for banks. An important reason why liquidity risk has decreased is the Riksbank's liquidity-enhancing measures and the government guarantee program. Now that the economy has rapidly deteriorated, and with that outlook for the banks' borrowers, credit risk has instead taken over as the most prominent risk. Our assessment is that the banks face significant credit losses but that they meet their capital requirements even when tested against a very severe stress scenario. Anyone interested in our overall analysis, the stress tests and how we assess the risks for different categories of borrowers, I refer to the report. I will just repeat what I have already said, namely that there is little indication that the Swedish household sector as a whole will cause any major credit losses. On the other hand, the high level of uncertainty about the economic outlook means that credit risk for the corporate sector has increased overall. And this also applies to the industry in which you operate. We are now living through a crisis that is exceptional both in depth and in its geographical spread. This raises a host of questions: When will normalisation in financial markets be restored? When will we see a recovery of our economies and will it last? And if the rise comes; how powerful will it be? Eventually, the question marks will be straightened out and then we'll see, to reconnect with Danny Kaye, whether the lucky owner is replenished for the property owners. (1) See Riksbank (2009), "Global recession and financial stability", Financial stability 2009:1. (2) Data from Svenskt Fastighetsindex/Investment Property Databank. (3) Data from Newsec.The real price is defined as the nominal price divided by consumer price index.

Mnga fastighetsbolag klmdes mellan fallande intkter och de snabbt stigande rntorna. Kostnaderna fr fastighetsbolagens ln kade markant och innebar i slutndan att flera, framfr allt hgbelnade, fastighetsbolag fick svrt att betala rntor och amorteringar p sina ln. Detta ledde i sin tur till kade kreditfrluster fr bankerna. I dag r de rntor som fastighetsbolagen behver betala fr sina ln betydligt lgre n de var p 1990-talet. Samtidigt r fastighetsbolagen i allmnhet mindre belnade n vad som var fallet p 1990-talet och deras finansiella stllning r ver lag bttre i dag n den var d. Dessutom har bankernas kreditprvning under brjan av 2000-talet fljt en annan filosofi n innan fastighetskrisen p 1990-talet. D fokuserade bankerna i stor utstrckning p panternas vrde, vrden som snabbt grptes ur i takt med att priserna sedermera fll. Numera lgger bankerna strre fokus p kundernas kassaflden och drmed deras frmga att betala p sina ln. I sammanhanget r det ocks vrt att sga att inslaget av svl utlndska investerare som finansirer framstr som strre under 2000-talet n under 1990talet. Nr vi i dag talar om kade svrigheter att hitta finansiering till fljd av den finansiella krisen tycks det ocks frst och frmst vara de utlndska investerarna och de utlndska finansirerna som har dragit sig tillbaka. De utlndska investerarna r ocks de som har haft strst andel lnat kapital i sina kp, varfr det ocks r de som har drabbats relativt sett hrdast i den finansiella krisen och av svrigheterna att hitta finansiering. men ocks vissa likheter ven om det finns stora skillnader mellan d och nu finns det ocks en del likheter. Frenklat kan man sga att priset p en fastighet avgrs av tv faktorer, nmligen det frvntade driftsverskottet p fastigheten och vilket frrntningskrav som investeraren har. Att investerare r beredda att betala mer fr en fastighet kan drfr vara en fljd antingen av att de frvntar sig att hyresintkterna kommer att ka eller att de inte krver att det kapital de investerar ska generera lika mycket i avkastning. Frn mitten av 1980-talet till 1990 steg priserna betydligt mer n hyrorna. Samma mnster gick igen under prisuppgngen frn 2005 till 2007. Vad vi drmed kan sga r att prisutvecklingen under de tv perioderna inte har drivits av det vi brukar kalla fundamentala faktorer. Det vill sga priserna har inte kat p grund av en kad efterfrgan p kontorslokaler, lgre vakanser och kade hyror. Istllet har prisuppgngen berott p att investerarna inte lngre har krvt lika hg avkastning p sina investeringar och vid slutet av 2007 var riskpremien nrmare noll. Utvecklingen mellan ren 2005 och 2007 var dock alls inte lika dramatisk som p 1980-talet, d fastighetsbubblan byggdes upp. Avkastningskravet p 1980-talet var stundtals till och med lgre n avkastningen p en statsobligation, vilket innebr att de som investerade i kommersiella fastigheter inte krvde ngon kompensation fr den risk de tog fr att placera i fastigheter. En annan likhet mellan d och nu r hur skeenden p de finansiella marknaderna kan pverka den kommersiella fastighetsmarknaden. Lite tillspetsat kan man sga att krisen p fastighetsmarknaden inleddes hsten 1990 nr finansbolaget Nyckeln inte kunde refinansiera sina ln. Nr Nyckeln och de vriga finansbolagen inte lngre kunde fortstta med sin utlning till fastighetsbolagen blev det brjan till slutet fr den kreditdrivna prisuppgngen. Som under 1990-talet har den nuvarande finansiella krisen inneburit att det blivit svrare fr fastighetsbolagen att hitta finansiering. Det kan slutligen nmnas att bankerna p det totala planet, allts inte bara nr det gller fastighetsrelaterade ln, str infr betydande kreditfrluster. Riksbankens bedmning i den senaste stabilitetsrapporten r att kreditfrlusterna i huvudscenariot uppgr till drygt tv procent av bankernas utlning 2009 och 2010. I ett stresscenario, med en betydligt smre realekonomisk utveckling, berknas de uppg till 4,3 procent av utlningen under samma period. Det r stora frluster men nd betydligt mer begrnsade n under 1990-talskrisen. D uppgick kreditfrlusterna 1991-1994 till 13 procent av den genomsnittliga utlningen under samma period och, som redan nmnts, hnfrde sig tv tredjedelar av frlusterna till fastighetsrelaterade ln. Denna gng r den enskilt strsta frlustkllan ln till de baltiska staterna och vriga steuropa. I bde huvudscenariot och stresscenariot berknas kreditfrlusterna i den utlningen st fr cirka 40 procent av de totala frlusterna. Ingen ny 1990-talskris men nd ett oskert lge Det finns allts flera skl till bedmningen att vi kommer att undg en ny fastighetskris av 1990-talssnitt; rntelget r i dag mer frmnligt, dagens situation har inte fregtts av den typ av byggboom som fregick 1990-talskrisen, bankernas lngivning fokuserar i dag mer p fastighetsbolagens betalningsfrmga n vrdet p deras tillgngar och belningsgraderna r i dag ver lag lgre jmfrt med 1990talet. Men oskerheten p marknaden r nd stor och det r vrt att lyfta fram de risker vi ser framver. Fr det frsta befinner vi oss i en djup lgkonjunktur och exakt hur mycket den kommer att pverka efterfrgan p lokaler r svrt att sia om. Av stor betydelse fr efterfrgan p kontorslokaler r sysselsttningen inom tjnstesektorn. Likt sysselsttningen verlag, har vi kunnat se att sysselsttningen inom tjnstesektorn har dmpats. Dremot har dmpningen kommit senare inom tjnstesektorn n vad den har gjort inom industrisektorerna. Bedmningen r dock att sysselsttningen inom tjnstesektorn kommer att dmpas ytterligare. Mot den bakgrunden r det rimligt att vnta sig att vi kommer att f se en svagare hyresutveckling och kade vakanser. Fastighetsbolagens intjning och frmga att betala rntor och amorteringar kommer drmed att frsmras och vi riskerar att f se fler betalningsinstllelser, ven bland fastighetsbolagen. Fr det andra kan de fallande priserna p fastigheter bli ett problem fr fastighetsbolagen nr de ska stta om sina ln hos bankerna om de inte lever upp till bankernas krav p maximalt tillten belningsgrad. Fr det tredje utgr de senaste rens kade inslag av utlndska banker p den svenska fastighetsmarknaden ett visst orosmoment. Detta p grund av att dessa banker nu till fljd av den finansiella krisen drar sig tillbaka och inte stter om ln p den svenska marknaden. De svenska brsnoterade fastighetsbolagen frefaller visserligen verlag vara mindre beroende av finansiering frn utlndska banker. Men inte desto mindre skulle de andra typer av aktrer som r beroende av denna typ av finansiering kunna f svrigheter att refinansiera sina ln eller f finansiering hos svenska banker. Att utlndska finansirer drar sig tillbaka skulle drtill kunna innebra ytterligare ett oskerhetsmoment p den svenska kommersiella fastighetsmarknaden ver lag och f den att framst som mindre attraktiv. Fr det fjrde finns det en risk att fastighetsbolagens rntekostnader kan ka mer n deras intjning nr konjunkturen tar fart och rntorna drmed stiger. Detta skulle kunna leda till att de fr svrare att betala av sina ln. Slutord Fr ett par veckor sedan publicerade vi en ny stabilitetsrapport. Jmfrt med vr bedmning i novemberrapporten, ser vi nu inte lngre att likviditetsrisken r den strsta risken fr bankerna. Ett viktigt skl till att likviditetsrisken har minskat r Riksbankens likviditetsfrmjande tgrder och det statliga garantiprogrammet. Nu nr konjunkturen snabbt frsmrats, och med de utsikterna fr bankernas lntagare, har kreditrisken istllet tagit ver som den mest framtrdande risken. Vr bedmning r att bankerna str infr betydande kreditfrluster men att de klarar sina kapitalkrav ven nr de testas mot ett mycket hrt stresscenario. Den som r intresserad av vr vergripande analys, stresstesterna och hur vi bedmer riskerna fr olika lntagarkategorier hnvisar jag till rapporten. Jag ska bara upprepa det jag redan sagt, nmligen att det inte finns mycket som tyder p att den svenska hushllssektorn i sin helhet kommer att orsaka ngra strre kreditfrluster. Dremot innebr den stora oskerheten om konjunkturutsikterna att kreditrisken fr fretagssektorn kat ver lag. Och det gller ven den bransch som ni r verksamma i. Vi genomlever nu en kris som bde till sitt djup och till sin geografiska spridning r exceptionell. Detta vcker en mngd frgor: Nr kommer normaliseringen p finansmarknaderna att vara terstlld? Nr fr vi se en terhmtning av vra ekonomier och blir den bestende? Och om uppgngen kommer; hur kraftfull blir den? S smningom kommer frgetecknen att rtas ut och d fr vi se, fr att teranknyta till Danny Kaye, om lyckobgaren fylls p fr fastighetsgarna. Title: The Riksbank and monetary policy
text: Wickman-Parak: The Riksbank and monetary policy Date 2007-08-14 Deputy Governor Barbro Wickman-Parak spoke today at a meeting at Swedbank in Stockholm. In his speech, Wickman-Parak presented his views on monetary policy and the decisions taken at the monetary policy meeting on 20 June. "In June, the Executive Board raised the repo rate from 3.25 to 3.50 percent and presented a new interest rate forecast. I supported both the rate hike and the repo rate forecast," Wickman-Parak began. "I saw the decision to raise interest rates as a natural step; several years of high growth have driven up resource utilisation, which is now slightly higher than normal, and cost pressures have increased. In the coming years, resources will be further stretched, leading to increased cost pressures. In order to prevent demand from picking up so much that the economy is overheating, and a cost/inflation spiral is set in motion, it was reasonable, in my view, for the repo rate to be raised roughly in line with the new interest rate forecast. I also argued that the repo rate for the June meeting was relatively low and that the hike to 3.50 did not change that," Wickman-Parak said. "A decision to raise interest rates leads to immediate delivery. The situation is different with the path of interest rates. In that case, it is a forecast of the repo rate. It extends over three years and is, of course, very uncertain. It does not imply a 'delivery guarantee' but we may have reasons to raise at a slower or faster pace, it is important to underline", stressed Wickman-Parak. "From June onwards, the names of the members of the Executive Board will be placed in the minutes of monetary policy meetings. Anyone who has read the Minutes of the June meeting will recognise what I am going to say here. I recapitulate the main motives for my position. I also do a few touchdowns on the events of the summer. The bank's new policy means that no signals of new monetary policy intentions should be given between monetary policy meetings. The fact that I am touching on any of what has happened since the June meeting should not be interpreted as meaning that I am in any respect a messenger of the Executive Board or that I am giving any signals as to how I will vote at the monetary policy meeting in September. Finally, I touch on the market reactions caused by the June interest rate decision," Wickman-Parak said. "At the June meeting, I highlighted the fact that fiscal policy means big tax cuts. They have immediate effects on household incomes and stimulate the demand for labor. The tax cuts and other measures are also aimed at increasing the supply of labor. How large the effects will be and when in time they will become more tangible is highly uncertain. So far, the supply of labor has increased but not in line with demand. The Riksbank's task is not to review fiscal policy, but to assess how different measures affect supply and demand in the economy and thus inflation is central to monetary policy," Wickman-Parak pointed out. "The development of labour costs per unit of output is of great importance for inflation. They are influenced by how wages and productivity develop. The collective bargaining process has resulted in wages increasing more than expected. In addition, there will be a wage slide, which in June was assumed to amount to about one percent per year in the coming years. At the same time, productivity is projected to develop weaker than in recent years. The size of wage slippage is hard to determine and productivity growth is a notoriously elusive variable. The latter varies greatly between quarters and we need to learn more about what drives it. Anyone who makes inflation forecasts has reason to try to improve their understanding of the development of productivity. But at the same time, there are reasons to be humbled by this task and to expect that we will be exposed to surprises in the future as well," Wickman-Parak noted. "Productivity is one of the factors that determines how much growth can be achieved without compromising the inflation target. The availability of labor is another. Compared with previous periods of strong economic activity, the reserve of labor is now slightly larger. But its composition is also of importance. How many people have a skill that is actually in demand? There is uncertainty about the answer to that question. The NIER's barometers show that the proportion of companies with labour shortages is increasing even though the proportion is not yet as high as in the previous boom," Wickman-Parak said. "Any signals that may indicate growing bottleneck issues, we need to closely follow up. A worsening labor shortage could force companies to push up compensation more than assumed in the monetary policy report. The alternative is for companies to waive the requirement for qualifications. This could be at the expense of productivity growth, which could then be weaker than forecast in June. In both cases, cost and inflationary pressures are rising," Wickman-Parak pointed out. "So a few words about household borrowing and home prices. The Riksbank has, and this bears repeating, no target for either house prices or household debt. What is clear, however, is that house prices and household indebtedness are now growing at a rate that is not sustainable in the long term. It is likely that a return to more sustainable growth rates will take place in an orderly manner. At the June meeting, however, I stressed that it cannot be ruled out that the adjustment will take place more abruptly, which in that case will have consequences for both growth and inflation. The raising of interest rates reduces the likelihood of such a scenario and thus contributes to balanced economic development," Wickman-Parak said. "A lot has happened since the June meeting. The implications of the new information for the repo rate will be discussed at the next monetary policy meeting on 6 September. Without prejudging the discussion, I would like to give a couple of examples of what I myself consider to be important pieces of the puzzle," Wickman-Parak said. "The quick version of national accounts for the second quarter was recently published. It confirms the Riksbank's forecast that the slump in Swedish growth in the first quarter was temporary in nature. GDP growth was marginally higher than our forecast from June. By contrast, employment measured by the number of hours worked was stronger than our forecast and, consequently, productivity growth was weaker than expected. The figures for the second quarter are based on incomplete data and are therefore uncertain and a revised version of the first quarter is not yet available to us. Since the June meeting, the LFS figures for the second quarter and the inflation figures for June and July have also been published. Employment measured by the number of people grew about as expected, while unemployment was slightly lower than forecast. The outcome for inflation has been roughly in line with our forecast in June. Thus, the domestic economy continues to develop strongly. Also in terms of developments in the rest of the world, new data generally confirm the picture of high global growth that was painted in the June monetary policy report. However, it is clear that the problems in the US mortgage market have led to increased uncertainty more generally in the financial markets. How these, and other factors, will affect our overall assessment will be something we will have to return to in connection with the next monetary policy meeting. We are, of course, following developments closely. When it comes to the Swedish money market, there are currently no liquidity problems. The market is functioning well," Wickman-Parak continued. "The market reaction was strong when the Executive Board's decision was published on 20 June. The krona strengthened and interest rates rose. The market's own expectations, as reflected in the implied forward rates the day before the decision, did not indicate that the surprise would be so great. Expectations were fairly well in line with the Riksbank's new interest rate path well into next year and then higher further ahead," Wickman-Parak said. "The Riksbank's new path for the repo rate at the end of 2007 was a little higher than the average forecast according to various market letters. But in the slightly longer term, several analysts predicted a higher interest rate than the Riksbank. Apparently, some analysts' expectations of the Riksbank's interest rate path differed from their own forecasts for the repo rate. Why is that? One interpretation may be that these analysts thought they had weighed up the information about inflationary pressures in the economy differently than the Riksbank. That such differences arise from time to time is not in itself remarkable. There are also different views on what will happen to the repo rate between different analysts," WickmanParak pointed out. "The decision to publish the interest rate path has meant a major change in the Riksbank's communication and a step towards greater clarity on the part of the Riksbank on how to view interest rate developments in the future. I believe that we are now in an intensive learning process where both the Riksbank and market players are gradually getting better at interpreting each other's reaction patterns. The Riksbank's lot is that we must constantly strive to improve our communication to become more predictable," Wickman-Parak said. "A natural consequence of presenting its own interest rate path is that the focus shifts from the current monetary policy decision, and also future monetary policy decisions in the near future, to longer-term developments. That's basically a good thing. Business and household decisions need to be based on an analysis of where interest rates are heading. At the same time, of course, the further forward we look, the greater the uncertainty and thus the scope for different assessments. There are no unambiguous truths. However, different assessments and considerations can be set against each other, which can give a more comprehensive picture of different possible development paths", concluded Wickman-Parak.
text_original: UTSKRIFT FRN WWW.RIKSBANK.SE Wickman-Parak: Riksbanken och penningpolitiken Datum 2007-08-14 Vice riksbankschefen Barbro Wickman-Parak talade idag vid ett mte p Swedbank i Stockholm. I sitt anfrande presenterade Wickman-Parak sin syn p penningpolitiken och besluten p det penningpolitiska mtet den 20 juni. I juni hjde direktionen reporntan frn 3,25 till 3,50 procent och presenterade en ny rnteprognos. Jag stllde mig bakom bde rntehjningen och prognosen fr reporntan, inledde Wickman-Parak. Jag sg beslutet att hja rntan som ett naturligt steg; flera r av hg tillvxt har drivit upp resursutnyttjandet som nu r ngot hgre n normalt och kostnadstrycket har tilltagit. De nrmaste ren anstrngs resurserna ytterligare vilket leder till ett kat kostnadstryck. Fr att hindra att efterfrgan tar s mycket fart att ekonomin verhettas, och en kostnads/inflationsspiral stts igng, var det enligt min uppfattning rimligt att reporntan skulle hjas ungefr i linje med den nya rnteprognosen. Jag frde ocks fram att reporntan infr junimtet var frhllandevis lg och att hjningen till 3,50 inte ndrade p det, sade Wickman-Parak. Ett beslut att hja rntan leder till omedelbar leverans. Annorlunda frhller det sig med rntebanan. I det fallet handlar det om en prognos fr reporntan. Den strcker sig ver tre r och r givetvis mycket osker. Ngon leveransgaranti innebr den inte utan vi kan f skl att hja i en lngsammare eller snabbare takt, det r viktigt att understryka, betonade Wickman-Parak. Frn och med juni stts namnen p direktionens medlemmar ut i protokollen frn de penningpolitiska mtena. Den som lst protokollet frn junimtet kommer att knna igen det jag hr ska ta upp. Jag rekapitulerar de viktigaste motiven fr mitt stllningstagande. Jag gr ocks ngra nedslag i sommarens hndelser. Bankens nya policy innebr att ngra signaler om nya penningpolitiska intentioner inte ska ges mellan de penningpolitiska mtena. Att jag berr ngot av det som hnt sedan junimtet ska inte tolkas som att jag i ngot avseende r en av direktionen utsnd budbrare eller att jag ger ngra signaler om hur jag kommer att rsta p det penningpolitiska mtet i september. Avslutningsvis berr jag de marknadsreaktioner som rntebeslutet i juni gav upphov till, sade Wickman-Parak. Vid junimtet framhll jag det faktum att finanspolitiken innebr stora skattesnkningar. De har omedelbara effekter p hushllsinkomsterna och stimulerar efterfrgan p arbetskraft. Skattesnkningarna och andra tgrder syftar ocks till att ka utbudet av arbetskraft. Hur stora effekterna blir och nr i tiden de blir mer ptagliga r hgst oskert. Hittills har utbudet av arbetskraft kat men inte i takt med efterfrgan. Riksbankens uppgift r inte att recensera finanspolitiken, men att bedma hur olika tgrder pverkar utbud och efterfrgan i ekonomin och drmed inflationen r centralt fr penningpolitiken, ppekade Wickman-Parak. Utvecklingen av arbetskostnaderna per producerad enhet r av stor betydelse fr inflationen. De pverkas av hur lner och produktivitet utvecklas. Avtalsrrelsen har resulterat i att lnerna kar mer n vntat. Drtill kommer lneglidningen som i juni antogs uppg till cirka en procent per r de kommande ren. Samtidigt berknas produktiviteten utvecklas svagare n under de senaste ren. Storleken p lneglidningen r svr att avgra och produktivitetstillvxten r en notoriskt svrfngad variabel. Den senare varierar starkt mellan kvartalen och vi behver lra oss mer om vad som driver den. Alla som gr inflationsprognoser har anledning att frska frbttra sin frstelse av produktivitetens utveckling. Men samtidigt finns det skl att knna dmjukhet infr denna uppgift och att rkna med att vi kommer att utsttas fr verraskningar ven i framtiden, konstaterade Wickman-Parak. Produktiviteten r en av de faktorer som bestmmer hur hg tillvxt som kan uppns utan att inflationsmlet ventyras. Tillgngen p arbetskraft r en annan. Jmfrt med tidigare perioder med stark konjunktur r reserven av arbetskraft nu ngot strre. Men dess sammansttning r ocks av betydelse. Hur mnga har en kompetens som faktiskt efterfrgas? Det rder oskerhet om svaret p den frgan. Konjunkturinstitutets barometrar visar att andelen fretag som har brist p arbetskraft kar ven om andelen nnu inte r lika hg som vid den frra hgkonjunkturen, sade Wickman-Parak. Alla signaler som kan indikera vxande flaskhalsproblem mste vi noga flja upp. En frvrrad brist p arbetskraft kan tvinga fretagen att pressa upp ersttningarna mer n som antogs i den penningpolitiska rapporten. Alternativet r att fretagen ger avkall p kravet p kvalifikationer. Det kan g ut ver produktivitetstillvxten som d kan bli svagare n vad som prognostiserades i juni. I bda fallen stegras kostnadsoch inflationstrycket, ppekade Wickman-Parak. S ngra ord om hushllens upplning och bostadspriserna. Riksbanken har, och detta tl att upprepas, inget ml fr vare sig bostadspriser eller hushllens skuldsttning. Vad som dremot str klart r att bostadspriserna och hushllens skuldsttning nu vxer i en takt som inte r lngsiktigt hllbar. Troligtvis kommer en tergng till mer hllbara kningstal att ske under ordnade former. P mtet i juni betonade jag emellertid att det inte kan uteslutas att anpassningen sker mer abrupt, vilket i s fall fr konsekvenser fr svl tillvxten som inflationen. Hjningen av rntan minskar sannolikheten fr ett sdant scenario och bidrar drmed till en balanserad ekonomisk utveckling, sade Wickman-Parak. En hel del har hnt sedan junimtet. Vilka konsekvenser den nya informationen kan ha fr reporntan diskuteras vid nsta penningpolitiska mte den 6 september. Utan att fregripa diskussionen vill jag hr ge ett par exempel p vad jag sjlv betraktar som viktiga pusselbitar, sade Wickman-Parak. Snabbversionen av nationalrkenskaperna fr andra kvartalet publicerades nyligen. Den bekrftar Riksbankens prognos om att svackan i svensk tillvxt frsta kvartalet var av tillfllig art. BNP-tillvxten blev marginellt hgre n vr prognos frn juni. Sysselsttningen mtt i antalet arbetade timmar blev dremot starkare n vr prognos och fljaktligen blev produktivitetstillvxten svagare n vntat. Siffrorna fr andra kvartalet baseras p ett ofullstndigt underlag och r drmed oskra och en reviderad version av frsta kvartalet har vi nnu inte tillgng till. Sedan junimtet har ocks AKU-siffrorna fr andra kvartalet och inflationssiffrorna fr juni och juli publicerats. Sysselsttningen mtt i antalet personer vxte ungefr som vntat medan arbetslsheten blev ngot lgre n prognostiserat. Utfallen fr inflationen har blivit ungefr i linje med vr prognos i juni. Den inhemska konjunkturen fortstter sledes att utvecklas starkt. ven nr det gller utvecklingen i omvrlden bekrftar nya data verlag den bild av hg global tillvxt som utmlades i den penningpolitiska rapporten i juni. Det r dock tydligt att problemen p den amerikanska bolnemarknaden lett till en kad oskerhet mer generellt p de finansiella marknaderna. Hur dessa, och andra faktorer, kommer att pverka vr samlade bedmning fr vi anledning att terkomma till i samband med nsta penningpolitiska mte. Vi fljer naturligtvis utvecklingen noga. Nr det gller den svenska penningmarknaden finns i dagslget inga likviditetsproblem. Marknaden fungerar vl, fortsatte Wickman-Parak. Marknadsreaktionerna blev kraftiga i samband med att direktionens beslut offentliggjordes 20 juni. Kronan strktes och rntorna steg. Marknadens egna frvntningar, ssom de avspeglades i de implicita terminsrntorna dagen fre beslutet, tydde inte p att verraskningen skulle bli s stor. Frvntningarna var ganska vl i linje med Riksbankens nya rntebana en bra bit in p nsta r fr att sedan ligga hgre lngre fram, sade Wickman-Parak. Riksbankens nya bana fr reporntan i slutet av 2007 lg lite hgre n den genomsnittliga prognosen enligt olika marknadsbrev. Men p lite lngre sikt var det flera analytiker som frutspdde en hgre rnta n Riksbanken.
